scientific_integrity: A fully stated analytic theorem with finite exact-rational consistency checks. No finite search is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Quantitative constants are not claimed optimal; applies only to noncollinear real zero-sum triples with defect at most 1/100 and to their two-dimensional span; bibliographic equivalence risk persists.
title: Quantitative affine-hexagonal rigidity from a nearly minimal three-vector separation
